messages.subject: Standard errors of b estimates
parts:
Have there been any updates in recent years toward the availability of a straightforward way to obtain standard errors of b estimates and the standard error of the discrimination parameter?  I am working with graded response models and have not found an answer on the web.  Also, there must be an easy way to plot the measurement error curve when producing the IIC in the ltm package.  I humbly submit that I am not very sophisticated as yet with R, albeit I find the packages for CFA and IRT to be fantastic.  Thanks in advance if someone can help.

Robert Semel

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Standard errors of b estimates
parts:
These can be computed via the delta method from coef(). See below for an example.

###
library(mirt)
dat <- expand.table(LSAT7)
mod <- mirt(dat, SE=TRUE)
plot(mod, type = 'SE')
itemplot(mod, 1, type = 'SE')

coef(mod, printSE=TRUE)
coef(mod, IRTpars=TRUE, printSE=TRUE)
###

Phil
